nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Use source and target product references to replace product content while preserving scene consistency.

denoiseStrength.description: Generation denoise strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

imageOutputHeight.description: Desired output height in pixels, from 32 to 4096.

imageOutputWidth.description: Desired output width in pixels, from 32 to 4096.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the base image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 384 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

targetOriginUrl.description: Public URL of the replacement product image.

name: nexscope_product_replacement
title: Product Replacement API
